# Hierarchical_Attachment

**Domain**: TCC
**First mentioned**: auto-extracted

## Definition
A growth rule where new nodes attach to existing nodes in a nested, level-based pattern, creating recursive community layers. Offers a scalable blueprint for designing multi-scale network fabrics that support both local processing and global coordination in in-network neuromorphic systems.
